authorized_request: Push current data to GitHub, optimize shapes and real materials until 06:00 Beijing, then optimize all-CDGM glass until 08:30 and deliver both result reports.
cdgm_resize_condition: General finalizer exit code zero and its owned job fully closed; restart owned six-worker search with --resume only if more than 45 seconds remain
constraints: A4/A6 only on S10; A2 and A8 or higher zero
105 degree full field, 52.5 degree half field
Common image plane for f/5.6, f/8, f/22; f/5.6 on-axis 20 lp/mm focus
No intersecting glass; air gaps including S6-to-S8 at least 0.3 mm
Rear air gap S10-to-S11 checked through conservative radial domain 15.8 mm with minimum gap at least 0.3 mm; 15.8 mm is a radius, not an axial spacing
Actual native glass catalog and six wavelength indices, no fictitious nd/Vd replacement

operations.phase_best_pointer: overnight_20260915/<phase>/best.json; source_path points to immutable best/candidate_NNNNN.zmx

report_requirements: Resumed optimization stops at 12:11:55 Beijing after Windows Update extension; subsequent work is validation and reporting only
Read PDF skill before authoring; start artifact marker with expected count 2 exactly once before first PDF
Generate both reports only from SHA-verified frozen phase sources and corresponding native results
Render and visually inspect every page of both PDFs before delivery
All legends outside axes; manual MTF colored lines without circle or cross markers
Provide independent all-CDGM catalog audit and native MTF results
Include material-combination Pareto and within-CDGM catalog relative-cost proxy; no invented currency quotes or cross-catalog savings percentages
Report unmet factory MTF targets honestly
Commit and push validated results to existing main without force
Pause heartbeat only after both reports and lens files are verified, pushed and delivered

resume_after_windows_update.reason: Windows Update restart reported by user; extend prior task by lost execution time
